name: Mesomelic and Rhizo-Mesomelic Dysplasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Mesomelic and Rhizo-Mesomelic Dysplasia

criteria.description: Presence of mesomelic and rhizo-mesomelic shortening of the limbs
Characteristic radiological findings including hypoplasia or aplasia of the radius and ulna or tibia and fibula
Mild facial dysmorphic features such as midface hypoplasia
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with mesomelic dysplasia (e.g., SHOX gene mutations)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of mesomelic and rhizo-mesomelic limb shortening with characteristic radiological bone abnormalities; genetic confirmation supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical and radiological; genetic testing can confirm but may not always be available.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Mesomelic shortening of forearms and lower legs
Rhizo-mesomelic shortening involving proximal and middle limb segments
searchTerms: short upper and middle limb bones

pathognomonic.symptomName: Hypoplasia or aplasia of radius and ulna bones
searchTerms: underdeveloped or missing radius and ulna
mild flatness of cheeks and nose

common.symptomName: Limited range of motion in affected joints

rare.symptomName: Respiratory complications due to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: lung issues due to rib cage

imaging: Radiographs showing mesomelic and rhizo-mesomelic limb shortening
Hypoplasia or aplasia of radius and ulna or tibia and fibula
Bowing and shortening of long bones
genetic: Pathogenic variants in SHOX gene or other genes implicated in mesomelic dysplasia
other: Clinical observation of limb shortening patterns

distinguishingFeatures: Disproportionate short stature with rhizomelic limb shortening
Characteristic facial features including frontal bossing and midface hypoplasia

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress due to thoracic cage deformity
Signs of spinal cord compression or neurological deficits
references: Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
Orphanet: Mesomelic and Rhizo-Mesomelic Dysplasia. ORPHA:93438.
Warman ML, Cormier-Daire V, Hall C, et al. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2010 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2011.
